brands.name: Matt Wilkerson Surfcraft
brands.short_description: Hand-shaped custom longboards, fishes, and twins by Matt Wilkerson on the Sunshine Coast — a Noosa label rooted in San Diego, Hawaii, and classic Volan craft.

models.name: Impala
models.description: The Impala is an incredible small wave design. A modified Pig shape outline — pulled-in nose and wider tail curving into a baby squash for easy early wave entry and accelerated manoeuvrability, with modest width and medium rail volume. Single nose concave to vee off the tail. Single fin with side bite. Glassed with 7.5 Volan; overall board weight is medium to heavy.

models.name: Mojo
models.description: Wide parallel outline for maximum trim and stability. Single nose concave and rolled vee bottom, 50/50 classic rails, balanced rocker, and heavy glass. Square tail, single fin — a 10" hatchet is recommended. Glassed in traditional 7.5 oz Volan.

models.name: Silver Ghost
models.description: Speed-shape outline with a pulled-in nose and tail, modest width, and medium rail volume. Single nose concave to vee off the tail. Glassed medium to heavy. Recommended as a single fin or box plus side-fin options.

models.name: Cali Kat
models.description: A versatile fish design born in San Diego waters for unlimited speed — point A to point B as fast as possible. Wider outline for stability and carry through flat sections. Wilkerson's interpretation uses 60/40 rails, glass-on handmade wood keel fins, and contemporary bottom contours: a slight rolled entry to single concave through the fins for a smooth ride.

models.name: Ala Moana
models.description: Beautiful overall template featuring a small flyer positioned perfectly to loosen the board up for a variety of conditions. Bottom contours include single entry concave flowing into a vee bottom with a slight double concave through the fins — a smooth, fast yet manoeuvrable ride.

models.name: Larry Bertlemann
models.description: Larry Bertlemann twin-fin reproduction shaped with flat decks, forgiving rails, extreme vee off the tail, and his signature flute channel splitting the vee. Developed with Bertlemann in the shaping room — a performance twin-fin design credited with low stylish turns and the pioneering Laerial manoeuvre.
